methods.label: Real SPHEREx L2 images
methods.description: DR1 + QR3 spectral images discovered with IRSA SIA2; small cutouts via the IRSA cutout service.

methods.label: Background
methods.description: SPHEREx ZODI model subtracted, then a per-cutout sigma-clipped median; local annulus background for photometry.

methods.label: Registration
methods.description: Every exposure reprojected onto one north-up TAN grid (6.15″/px) using its own WCS (bilinear). Gaia-based offsets are measured and reported, not applied.

methods.label: Visit stacks
methods.description: Inverse-variance weighted mean per visit and detector; hard-flagged pixels masked; SOURCE flag never masked.

methods.label: Difference imaging — simple
methods.description: Z = (S_b − S_a)/√(V_a+V_b) on registered stacks with combined masks; flux scale checked.

methods.label: Difference imaging — PSF-matched (Gaussian approximation)
methods.description: Sharper stack convolved with a Gaussian from the header PSF_FWHM difference; variance propagated. This is NOT ZOGY or Alard–Lupton.

methods.label: Aperture photometry
methods.description: r = 1 FWHM, annulus 2–3.5 FWHM, MJy/sr → µJy via pixel solid angle, ePSF or Gaussian aperture correction; saturated apertures reported as lower limits.

methods.label: On-the-fly spectrum
methods.description: Each exposure gives one (λ, F) point; λ from the WCS-WAVE table at the target pixel; binned to 102 channels.

methods.label: Astrometry
methods.description: 2-D Gaussian centroids on visit stacks; weighted linear PM fit with catalog parallax (free parallax when ≥4 epochs over ≥1 yr).

methods.label: Evidence tiers
methods.description: Rule-based confidence tiers and deterministic classification; not calibrated probabilities.
